{"query":"MATCH (m:Meeting)
OPTIONAL MATCH (res:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m)
WITH m, collect(DISTINCT res) AS resList
WITH m, size(resList) AS totalRes,
     size([r IN resList WHERE EXISTS {
       MATCH (r)-[:REFERENCES]->(d)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company)
       WHERE toLower(c.companyName) CONTAINS 'huawei'
          OR any(a IN (CASE WHEN c.aliases IS NULL THEN [] WHEN c.aliases='' THEN [] ELSE (CASE WHEN valueType(c.aliases)='LIST<STRING NOT NULL>' THEN c.aliases ELSE [c.aliases] END) END) WHERE toLower(a) CONTAINS 'huawei')
     }]) AS huaweiRes
WHERE totalRes > 0
RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS canonicalMeetingNumber,
       toFloat(huaweiRes)/totalRes AS ratio
ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt","abstain":false}
